overview_description.description: Pocket is a technology company that develops an AI-enabled note-taking system combining a dedicated recording device with companion software. Its platform records in-person conversations and phone calls, transcribes audio, and organizes the content into searchable transcripts, summaries, action items, and mind maps. The system supports offline recording, cloud synchronization, and access across mobile, desktop, and web applications, with support for more than 120 languages. Pocket also provides AI-powered features for organizing, searching, and exporting recorded information while offering integrations with task management workflows. Its products are designed for individuals and teams who need to capture, organize, and retrieve information from conversations and spoken ideas.
